analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see stance for the past 2 sessions. RSI is at 46.1 in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram shows improvement (-0.0418) but remains negative. Volume ratio of 0.31 (below 5-day average) indicates subdued activity, lowering conviction for trend change. SMA5 ($348.68) and SMA20 ($346.35) are above the current price ($344.26), acting as resistance. While the 4.10% rise above SMA200 ($330.71) is positive, the price remains in a sideways consolidation 30.4% below its 52-week high.

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low) — 회복 신호, 상승 가능성 시사
[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($344.26) vs SMA5 ($348.68)/SMA20 ($346.35)/SMA50 ($354.10) — Entering short-term resistance zone, below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($352.03)/SMA200 ($330.71) — Above long-term trend, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (69.6%) + Current price range in a pullback phase from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (52.4 → 46.1) — Staying neutral, consolidating after exiting oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (3.7344 → -0.0418) — Improving trend, remaining in negative territory.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $346.35) — Sideways near the middle band, with a narrowing band width of 17.88%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($330.20) — Based on SMA200, next support level on decline.
· Swing resistance ($349.00) — Based on SMA5, expectation of upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low) — Recovery signal, suggesting upward potential.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Enter long on breakout above $349.00, wait-and-see if $330.20 breaks.
